page.title: Foundation: Galactic Frontier – Steam Release & Free MMO
page.meta_description: Foundation: Galactic Frontier is a free-to-play sci-fi adventure on Steam. Build a starship, recruit crew, fight TPS battles, and command fleets.
page.tagline: Trade, fight, and build your own starship in the official Foundation universe.
overview: Foundation: Galactic Frontier is a free-to-play sci-fi game set in Isaac Asimov's official Foundation universe, the novels that also inspired the Apple TV+ series. The Steam page describes a falling Galactic Empire, rising factions, and a story tied to Seldon's Plan and the mysterious Mule. FunPlus International AG is listed as both developer and publisher, with a Steam release date of Nov 5, 2026.

You play as an interstellar trader, bounty hunter, and political strategist moving between the Empire, Foundation, other factions, and rebels. Your mothership is a buildable space home: construct cabins for food, water recycling, and steel, arm cannons, and handle crew emergencies together. Recruit heroes such as a knowledgeable robot, a legendary space cowboy, and even a most-wanted criminal.

Combat blends TPS firefights with fleet strategy. Build 3-hero strike teams from 15+ heroes, mixing tank, DPS, and healer roles. In galaxy wars, command Kinetic, Ion, and Beam craft, set formations with different flagships, assign commanders, and protect trade routes with alliances.

how_to_play: Build your mothership cabins for food, water recycling, and steel, and arm the ship with cannons.
Recruit heroes from different backgrounds and invite them onboard your starship home.
Form a 3-hero strike team and mix tank, DPS, and healer roles for TPS firefights.
Command fleets in galaxy wars using Kinetic, Ion, and Beam combat craft classes.
Set fleet formations with flagships, assign commanders, and protect your trade routes from threats and rivals.
Join alliances and take part in large-scale interstellar conflicts.
tips: Use a tank-DPS-healer trio when building your 3-hero strike team.
Master the three combat craft classes—Kinetic, Ion, and Beam—and deploy them in optimal formations.
Assign the right commanders to flagships to unlock their full power.
Protect trade routes from rivals while expanding your galactic trade empire.
Keep your mothership supplied with food, water recyclers, and steel.
Foster bonds with your crew and handle emergencies together.

faq.q: When does Foundation: Galactic Frontier release on Steam?
faq.a: The Steam store lists Nov 5, 2026 as the release date.

faq.q: Is Foundation: Galactic Frontier free to play?
faq.a: Yes. The Steam page marks it as free to play.

faq.q: What platforms is Foundation: Galactic Frontier on?
faq.a: Steam lists Windows. A YouTube tutorial title also references iOS and Android.
FunPlus International AG is listed as both developer and publisher on Steam.

faq.q: Is Foundation: Galactic Frontier based on Isaac Asimov's Foundation?
faq.a: Yes. The Steam page calls it the official Foundation universe and references Isaac Asimov's novels and the Apple TV+ series.
The provided sources do not list specific key bindings or button controls. Use the in-game tutorial for controls.
